title: MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted
summary: Bitcoin Magazine MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted MSCI publishes its November index review at 5 p.m. ET, the first under a new non-operating company screen. Its potential list, built on Sept. 30 filings, already marks Strategy, Metaplanet and three others as Deleted. This post MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
